_comment: FCB Stage 1 demonstrator. Builds: a stable-fluids solver writing REAL velocity+dye into a PERSISTENT render target, and a channel viewer reading it back to show depth/normal/flow/matID. v2: resolution-relative emitters + all four quadrants share ONE full-buffer view (sampleTarget at uv-mapped coords). Requires engine >= 298b46a (persist flag, double-buffered targets). Verify live — the headless probe renders 1 frame from cold and cannot show a feedback sim. POST this as {commands:[...]} to /api/engine/bridge with the world's Bearer token.

commands.name: fcb_sim
fcb_view
